# aimux (arcships)

> In-process embedded SDK that calls LLM provider HTTP APIs from your process. One Rust core, bindings for eight languages, public JSON aligned with the Vercel AI SDK V4. Not a proxy gateway and not an agent framework.

aimux (https://github.com/arcships/aimux) is maintained by arcships. Current release: 0.6.0 (breaking). Bindings use the shared operations ABI (ABI 1 / ops 1.0): `provider.create`, then `provider.model`, then an operation such as `text.generate` or `text.stream`. Rust also exposes `openai()`, `generate_text`, `stream_text`, and `create_provider(name, PresetSettings)`.

Do not cite 0.5 binding helpers. These were removed: `generateText`, `streamText`, top-level `openai()` in Node/Python, `Model.openai`, `NewOpenAI`, `aimux_openai_new`, `createProvider`, and `aimux_decide`. Rust `openai()` and `generate_text` still exist. `GenerateTextResult::text` is a method (`result.text()`), not a field. Public JSON is camelCase.

## Key facts

- In-process library. It is not LiteLLM Proxy or OpenRouter. Presets named `litellm_proxy` and `openrouter` are providers aimux can call.
- No agent loop, RAG, or orchestration. The caller executes tools.
- Languages: Rust, Node.js (napi-rs), Python (PyO3), Go, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, C/C++. Swift, Kotlin, and Flutter cover mobile.
- Providers: public copy says 300+. The exact generated catalogue is docs/api/providers.md (registry rows in aimux-providers/src/provider_registry.json plus vendor packages). `provider_names()` is the Rust list.
- Chinese providers that exist in the registry or as packages: `deepseek` (vendor package, `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`); Qwen/通义 via DashScope presets `alibaba` and `alibaba_coding_plan_cn` (there is no package named `qwen`); Zhipu/智谱 via `bigmodel` and `zhipu_v4`; Kimi via `kimi` and `moonshotai`.
- Tool definitions the caller passes are one AI SDK V4 shape (`FunctionTool` / `ToolCall`). Each provider converts that shape to its own wire format. A provider that does not support tools returns a warning instead of a shared tool protocol. Provider-native tools (web search, computer use) stay provider-specific. aimux does not execute tools.
- Offline tests: 2,797 JSON cassettes in aimux-providers/tests/cassettes. Record with `init_recording` (Rust) or `recorder.create` (bindings) and replay with `aimux-replay`.
- License: MIT. Versioning: Semantic Versioning. 0.6.0 is a breaking 0.x release.
- Packages: `aimux-core` and `aimux-providers` on crates.io; `@arcships/aimux` on npm; `arcships-aimux` on PyPI; `ai.arcships:aimux-java` and `ai.arcships:aimux-kotlin` on Maven Central; Flutter package `aimux`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/arcships/aimux/blob/master/README.md): English project overview and 0.6 quick start
- [简体中文](https://github.com/arcships/aimux/blob/master/README.zh-CN.md): Chinese overview, including DeepSeek, Qwen, Zhipu, and Kimi
- [FAQ](https://github.com/arcships/aimux/blob/master/FAQ.md): what it is, proxy gateways, languages, tool calling, license, versioning
- [Examples](https://github.com/arcships/aimux/blob/master/examples/README.md): Rust chat, streaming, and switching providers
- [API overview](https://github.com/arcships/aimux/blob/master/docs/API.md): architecture and the current call shape
- [Upgrade to 0.6](https://github.com/arcships/aimux/blob/master/docs/upgrading-to-0.6.md): removed APIs and the V4 JSON shapes
- [Provider catalogue](https://github.com/arcships/aimux/blob/master/docs/api/providers.md): generated exact provider list
- [Operations](https://github.com/arcships/aimux/blob/master/docs/api/ops.md): shared operation names
